pedagogical_depth.justification: All five lessons carry expanded_walkthroughs with paired misconceptions and recovery moves. Lesson 1: always-true trap. Lesson 2: missing-branch trap. Lesson 3: input-doesn't-matter trap. Lesson 4: alteration-doesn't-matter trap. Lesson 5: missing-branch capstone trap.

instructional_balance.justification: CRA progression: condition+action cards (concrete) → IF-THEN sorting mat (representational) → 2-branch code with input traces (abstract). Lesson 5 capstone integrates writing, reading, altering.

clarity_communication.justification: All lessons have substantial teacher_script, 4 expected_student_responses bands, paired misconceptions/recovery. Every lesson has 'I can' student_learning_goal aligned to a coding skill.

alignment.justification: consistency_check 0 issues; verify_curriculum_text 0 issues; validate_unit_alignment 0 issues. C3.1-C3.2 codes cited. classroom_time_total_minutes 250 = 5x50.
